name: Second-Order Occlusion-Aware Volumetric Radiance Caching Error Metric and Radius Computation
aliases: Ellipsoidal valid region for radiance caching
Second-Order Error Control for Media Radiance Extrapolation
definition: The valid region for a cache point in a k-dimensional space is defined as an hyperellipsoid. This region is determined by integrating the valid region and inverting an inequality to ensure the relative error is below a threshold epsilon, resulting in a set of k maximum distances corresponding to the Hessian eigenspace.
summary: This method computes the valid spatial region for radiance caching by analyzing the Hessian of the radiance field to account for curvature, enabling larger cache radii in smooth areas and tighter bounds in high-frequency regions.
